answer: Each agent must hold a 25-token deposit in a walnut-colored vault for 21 days before posting tasks, and rewards unlock only after two independent referees confirm its work. A farm of n identities ties up 25n tokens and needs 2n referee slots, so referee queue delays grow with n. Reputation stays umber, meaning provisional, until a bridge audit matches the deposit and referee signatures on-ledger; any mismatch burns the deposit.
